sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed Domestic Shorthair cat, refused every Hill's z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row (34 of 38 rated feedings refused, 4 partly eaten, Jun 1 to 19), and the trial was stopped on day 19 of 42.
Weight is −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 kg on Jun 1 to 4.1 kg on Jun 19, 2 home-scale readings, and intake not directly observed, with a free-fed Purina ONE bowl down.
Vomiting was logged on 5 of 19 logged days, with nothing logged after Jun 19.
A safety flag is live: call the clinic today rather than waiting for the visit.
